verdict.rationale: PayPal's agentic-commerce offering is entirely merchant-side (payment acceptance, catalog sync, cart APIs) and requires merchants to onboard via form-gated access, Braintree accounts, or Google enablement — there is no evidence of a keyless, self-service product/service search surface that an AI agent can query across merchants without a private partnership. The MCP server and agent toolkit are for merchants/developers to manage orders, invoices, and disputes, not for agents to discover products across arbitrary merchants.
